cohort: The study included 1080 patients undergoing cholecystectomy, caesarean sections, hip prosthesis, knee prosthesis, and colon surgery in Slovenian acute care hospitals between 2013 and 2016.
finding: The estimated SSIs incidence rates varied significantly between different surgical categories and participating hospitals, with some rates being rather high in comparison to reference data for EU/EEA countries.
mod_finding: The pooled in-hospital SSI incidence density for caesarean section was 3.7 (95% CI: 1.4-8.1) per 1000 post-operative patient-days.
